What if you wore your outdoor shoes inside every day?
In many American homes, wearing shoes inside is totally normal. It saves time. Many homes in Japan, Korea and Canada take shoes off at the door.

But here's the twist. Shoe soles pick up dirt and bacteria from the street, and one study found fecal bacteria on almost every shoe it tested! Your floor is where babies crawl and pets lie down, so a shoe rack by the door is an easy fix. Indoor slippers keep your feet warm and your floors much cleaner.
